cause: Float and Pin previously shared floating behavior without a meaningful interaction distinction, and Open Report only changed the view without requesting focus on the top composer.

evidence.ref: The report review drag handle now disables pointer and keyboard movement while pinned; Open Report increments a focus request consumed by the top Report composer; control glyphs use explicit float, pin, dock, and directional collapse icons.

impact: Users can distinguish movable floating review from position-locked pinned review, and can return from an empty review state directly to the writing input.
lesson: Window controls need distinct state semantics, not only distinct labels; navigation actions that return to an existing view must also provide a visible focus target.
